data.title: bn-2fs6: projection-level simulation; cursor prefix digest fix

data.reason: Core fix correct: every production cursor writer (rebuild, incremental_apply, Projector::update_cursor_to_event_log_end) records the prefix digest; write_hwm is test-only, so no rebuild-every-command regression. Digest cost is small next to event_log_cursor's full parse. read_content_range across shards is correct; a short log yields None and forces a rebuild. Verified: with 804d8090 bones-core, both regression fixtures and seed 14/15 of the campaign fail; with the fix bones-sim and bones-core tests pass. Non-blocking: (1) TOCTOU: rebuild/incremental hash the prefix after reading content, so a git rewrite between read and hash can record a digest that matches content never projected; hash the bytes actually consumed. (2) V4 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN is not idempotent; two processes migrating at once make the second fail and full-rebuild. (3) No bones-core unit tests for ensure_projection prefix check or Projector digest recording; the sim drives only incremental_apply. (4) Shrinker: removing a Redact target leaves target_step pointing at the next step's event. (5) Sim does not count incremental vs full-rebuild applies, so reachability of the incremental path is unmeasured; no partial pulls, month rollover, or sealed shards.
